title: Poly Network — Cross-Chain Administrator Privilege Hijacking Vulnerability Analysis
loss_raw: ~$611,000,000 (Largest DeFi hack at the time of the attack)
root_cause: `verifyHeaderAndExecuteTx()` does not block calls to the `EthCrossChainData` contract, allowing cross-chain messages to replace the keeper public key and transfer arbitrary funds
